summary: K Wave Media Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing its Annual General Meeting (AGM) scheduled for July 10, 2026. The filing includes the proxy statement and proxy card as exhibits, along with a proposed Second Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association subject to shareholder approval, which may include a name change. This is a routine AGM notice and governance update for a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer. No special-situation event, such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring, is involved. The filing is a standard periodic report and not a special situation under the classification framework.
